collect_note: Reads the Western SARE 'Grants' index, one card per current Western SARE call (Research & Education pre-proposal, Graduate Student, Professional + Producer, Farmer/Rancher, Professional Development, Local Education & Demonstration, Visiting Research & Education) with its listed deadline; Grants.gov search2 has no Western SARE calls (ALN 10.215 and keyword probes returned none), the /feed endpoint returns HTTP 500, and no JSON or RSS source exists, so the program index is the best public source; when a new cycle is posted the card's date and title change and the next call appears on the same page.
